title: Anonymization of headers doesn't work internally
body:
As already written in issue #1776 the headers are not replaced in case the email has been sent internally.
(see https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/issues/1776#issuecomment-430133810).

How is it possible to mitigate that?
author: Participant 1
